name: Foretold Ruin (3-4)

source.title: Pathfinder Society Scenario #2-21: In Pursuit of Water

disable: DC 20 Thievery check (trained) to scratch out a pillar's runes, Dispel Magic (2nd rank; counteract DC 18) to counteract a pillar's magic, or Athletics (Force Open) to push a pillar over. Disabling a pillar requires two actions. Disabling all four pillars or slaying Sezruth disables the trap
routine:
Routine (4 actions) The trap loses 1 action each turn for each disabled pillar. On its initiative, the trap uses each action to afflict a different non-evil creature in the room with thirst. The creature must attempt a DC 20 Fortitude save save.

---

Critical Success The creature is temporarily immune to additional negative effects from the foretold ruin hazard's reaction for 24 hours. The hazard has no awareness of this immunity and continues to target this creature.

Success The creature is unaffected.

Failure The creature is Fatigued until they drink water. If the creature was already fatigued, they take 1d6 nonlethal mental damage.

Critical Failure The creature is fatigued until they drink water and takes 1d6 nonlethal mental damage. If the creature was already fatigued, they instead take 2d6 nonlethal mental damage.

items.name: Spite
items.text:
Trigger A non-evil creature enters the room.

---

Effect The trap casts Phantom Pain on the creature, and then rolls initiative.

DC 23 Will save save

text: Daemonic curses slither and crawl through malevolent runes carved in four stone pillars. HP is per-pillar.
